notes.title: Quick game stream for the Steam Next Fest!
notes.notes: The Case of Andrew D. combines digital forensics and OSINT in a unique alternate reality game - you help private eyes to investigate cases for their clients, using original files and real world data. During the quick stream you will learn about basic mechanics of the game and what it is about. We will try to solve one of the cases from the demo, and start another one - but not spoiling the solution itself.
